messages:
Kai: restore for org-042 failed at 04:07 UTC with KMS "AccessDeniedException" when trying to decrypt snapshot s3://backups/org-042/2026-03-21.snap :warning:
Kai: log excerpt: `User arn:aws:sts::111122223333:assumed-role/restore-worker is not authorized to perform kms:Decrypt on key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/zz99-88aa`
Lea: was there a rotation window this morning?
Kai: yes, key-rotator ran a rotation at 01:10 UTC. rotation job shows retire-grants step completed.
Marco: likely the retire step removed the grant that restore-worker uses. we should avoid leaving a gap during rotation.
Lea: short-term mitigation: create a short-lived "rotation-bridge" grant scoped to restore-worker and resume restore. tag it and auto-retire in 6h. example:
```
aws kms create-grant \
  --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/zz99-88aa \
  --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/restore-worker \
  --operations Decrypt --name rotation-bridge-20260321
```
Lea: include tag `incident=org-042-restore` so we can find and expire it.
sec-bot: runbook-suggestion: add step "create rotation-bridge grant before retiring previous grants" and a canary decrypt from restore-worker.
Olivia: medium-term pattern: implement "bridge key" flow: when rotating, provision a transient alias that points to both keys during cutover so restores have a stable alias. after validation, switch alias to new key and retire old key. reduces grant churn.
Marco: note on RBAC mapping: we need a single source-of-truth doc mapping IAM roles -> expected KMS grants and which snapshots they must access. I'll draft the doc and link it to rotation-runner PR.
Lea: detection idea: CloudTrail alert when RetireGrant removes last grant for a CMK AND there have been snapshot API calls (PutObject/GetObject/Restore) for that tenant in the past 48h. escalate to eng-security.
Kai: creating temporary rotation-bridge grant now. GrantId: g-bridge-77 returned. passing GrantToken to restore job.
Marco: rotation-runner currently parallelizes retire/create. cause: race where retire wins before mirror create completes. fix: add leader election + transactional ordering or use a two-phase commit: (1) create mirrored grants on new key, (2) validate decrypts, (3) retire old grants.
Olivia: also propose a small persistent transition role (restore-transition-role) with minimal decrypt rights used only during rotation windows. guarded by policy and MFA for sensitive ops.
Lea: send SEC ticket and owner.
sec-bot: ticket created SEC-6033 "rotation: implement bridge-key + idempotent grant choreography" assigned to infra-team oncall.
Marco: action items:
- Kai: create bridge grant (done) and verify restore (ETA 15m)
- Marco: draft RBAC->KMS mapping one-pager (ETA EOD)
- Olivia: design bridge-key alias pattern and rotation-runner PR (ETA 2d)
- Lea: SOC detection rule for orphaned-keys during retire (ETA 24h)
sec-bot: note: add telemetry enrichment: include KeyId, GrantId stub, and alias in restore failure logs to speed triage.
Kai: restore resumed at 04:15 UTC and completed successfully at 04:28 UTC. data validation passed. closing once SEC-6033 has ETA and PRs linked. :white_check_mark:
